reviews.title: I had a very good experience with…
reviews.body:
I had a very good experience with Lebara. The service was smooth, reliable, and the overall process was easy and convenient.

I would especially like to appreciate Amisha Kazi for her excellent support and helpful attitude. She was polite, professional, and very supportive throughout the process. She explained everything clearly and made sure I received the right assistance.

Thank you, Amisha, and the Lebara team for providing such a great customer experience. I am very satisfied with the service and would definitely recommend Lebara to others.

reviews.title: Promising Offers, Poor Follow-Up
reviews.body:
ood introductory offers, but the customer service is quite poor if you ever need assistance. The India call centre keeps passing you from one person to another, even for simple requests, which makes resolving issues unnecessarily frustrating.

Also, if you offer an incentive such as “Get 3GB of data when you download the app,” it should actually be provided. Unfortunately, this offer appears to be misleading, as the promised data was not received.
